whole_evidence.text: --- record_id: mytheme-neumann-images title: Neumann images and plate relations aliases: - Neumann images and plate relations record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Argued from source_ids: - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - gebser-1985-ever-present-origin - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 --- # Neumann images and plate relations ## #0 The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them can stand apart and call them parents. In Neumann's creation sequence, heaven and earth, nourishment and danger, containing body and emerging child have yet to acquire the separateness through which a world becomes inhabitable. The round holds their possibility together. Its apparently enclosed outline carries the life that will differentiate it: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth. The future ego depends upon this containing life before it can represent that dependence. The first pressure in the image is therefore genesis: how a world and a centre within that world become distinct through a relation neither creates alone. This whole carries **shared archetypal structuration**: genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. It is the archetypal ground through which geographically situated tellings and temporal developments become comparable. Geography gives each telling its people, language and historical home; temporality gives its transformations their order and duration. Those registers remain distinct from the common structure disclosed here. The universal field belongs to the essay's native QL account; Neumann supplies a developed psychological morphology through which that field receives an imaginal and bodily refraction. His sequence is neither the derivation of QL nor a geographical address for the universal. [Neumann's source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **sources** the telling: the uroboros, Great Mother, separation of the World Parents, birth of the hero, slaying of mother and father, liberation of the captive and treasure, then the Osiris transformation. His book presents these as stages in the development of consciousness. The source's stadial claim remains attributable to Neumann. The essay's structural priority of relation does not require every society or person to have passed through this single historical sequence. Equally, the source's historical limitations do not reduce the shared archetypal operation to a merely local European image. In the first round, the paternal and maternal are still together. The uroboros can contain both without assigning them the exclusive offices they will receive after separation. Calling it mother at this point emphasises enclosure and nurture; calling it the unity of the parents emphasises the difference it contains before that difference becomes an opposition for a subject. These are distinguishable relations within the image. A single outline cannot settle them. Neumann's movement begins when what contained the ego becomes something the ego can face, desire, fear and resist. The telling below is a paraphrased reconstruction from the canonical source account and the page-anchored encounter preserved beside it. The encounter is not a verified transcript of Neumann. Its source leads and Taylor's authored responses are distinguished throughout; the external quotation and edition-collation debts remain at the return. ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round. ## #2 Separation of the World Parents opens the interval in which a world can appear. Heaven is distinguishable from earth; light can enter the space between them. An undifferentiated enclosure becomes an articulated field with directions and contrasts. The ego emerges within this opening as a position able to discriminate. What appears outside it becomes nameable because the act of differentiation has also given the observer a place. The transmitted creation scene at the encounter's p.105 lead requires its own sequence. The primordial person recognises itself, then divides into the paired figure of man and woman previously held as if in an embrace. Self-recognition precedes sexual separation in this telling. The androgyne therefore performs a relational office: the two who become partners arise through differentiation of a prior togetherness. The image places sex and gender within a genesis of relation; its use here depends upon preserving the before, the embrace, the division and the changed relation afterward. The independent primary passage and its exact translation remain a source debt. Neumann's psychological reading stresses the achievement of ego identity and the discriminating consciousness that says I am I. Taylor's response separates that achievement from the more primordial self-recognition expressed in the native relation. Prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when an ego takes possession of an identity; the finite experiencer and its inner instrument are determinations within the field of appearing. This authored distinction **returns-to** [the tattvic differential field](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), and **qualifies** [the bounded subject-position](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) and [the inner instrument](../../../episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). The acquisition of a determinate I is a real formation. It cannot retrospectively produce the awareness through which the acquisition appears. **Human-amplified: yes** for this explicit correction in Taylor's encounter; the psychological and Śaiva source offices retain their own evidence requirements. Light brings more than a collection of visible objects. In the leads at pp.106–109, an oriented world appears: above and below, before and behind, inside and outside, I and you, sacred and profane, good and evil. Boundaries make a precinct, a possession, a law and an order of action possible. Some of those institutional consequences are Taylor's authored extension of the encounter, not a verified universal history derived from Neumann. Their formal pressure is exact: a measure both reveals a field and selects what will count within it. [Māyā as operative measure](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **qualifies** this refraction. Differentiation is productive; its danger begins when the selected measure conceals its dependence upon a wider field. The image cannot be held to a fixed light/good and dark/bad dictionary. Light names disclosure from one position; what that position leaves unlit belongs to the same field. Father and mother, active and receptive, inner and outer likewise change office with the direction of the relation. Taylor's local p.108 appointment of night at #0, day at #5 and four directions at #1–#4 gives this encounter a 4+2 articulation: the spatially specified field is held through implicate conditions of appearance and return. **Human-amplified: yes** for that local appointment. It does not appoint every creation myth to six universal episodes or make time and space interchangeable. The twins give this danger two faces within one genesis. Taylor's [core theorem account, IV](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** the named Ohrmazd/Ahriman appointment: the broken halves of a prior `0` become enemies when their division is made to deny their belonging. [Q27's energetics and Neumann return](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** the same operation at the good/evil twins. Their opposition has real force; what changes is how the relation between them is held. Through `/`, their different valences still have one ground. When the stroke becomes addition between isolated signs, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, the meeting cancels them. When it becomes subtraction, `(-1)-(+1)=-2` or `(+1)-(-1)=+2`, one side takes the span as its own. The other is then encountered only as what must disappear for the governing side to be whole. The return has to preserve the two who can recognise their shared genesis. Blending them would destroy the difference through which recognition occurs; victory understood as abolishing the other's ground would perpetuate the divorce. The prior `0` returns as their condition, rather than as the null result of their collision. The narrative pressure is therefore the same one that will meet the hero: what kind of separation permits a life in relation, and what kind makes continued separation its war? This authored image **returns-to** [A13's two logics](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) through the changed operator, and **returns-to** [A18's complete field](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) without substituting two gods for its eight determinations. **Human-amplified: yes** for this existing Taylor operation, now made explicit in its assigned whole. Ohrmazd and Ahriman retain the naming supplied by the core; no independent Zurvanite telling, chronology, ritual or account of an historical orthodoxy has been recovered here. The core's fall-administering-itself judgment is its mythemic interpretation. Historical attribution remains a separate source task. Neumann's comparative morphology supplies the shared separation field; it is not being cited as the source of Taylor's notation or as verification of this named religious history. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. The emerging ego suffers the break it must accomplish. Its weakness and dependence do not disappear because it can name itself; the power of discrimination exposes them differently. The separation cannot simply be reversed without surrendering the differentiated life it enabled. This is why the story must pass through the hero. Something has to bear the cost of leaving while finding a relation to what has been left. ## #3 The hero is born within the world opened by the separation. Neumann's sequence then carries two emancipations: the slaying of the mother, followed by the slaying of the father. The maternal struggle addresses the engulfing origin from which the hero must become distinct. The paternal struggle addresses the authority that can arrest that emergence in an inherited order. If the telling stopped after escape from the mother, the father's law could simply inherit the power of enclosure. Keeping both struggles in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, rather than to the replacement of one captor by another. The violence belongs to the mythic and psychological telling. Its operation is differentiation from an overwhelming archetypal claim. Neumann's historically gendered morphology remains visible as his account. The page's relational reading follows the changing offices in the drama, including the earlier androgyne and the later possibility of partnership. Removing those changes would turn a developing relation into a static classification of persons. The next movement is the captive, the treasure and liberation. In the book's order this precedes the Osiris transformation. The achieved power to separate is now tested by what it releases and what becomes available through release. A captive liberated into another form of possession would leave the deeper problem intact. That last sentence states the essay's authored pressure upon the image: heroic efficacy has to be judged by the relation it makes possible, including the freedom of what it encounters. It does not invent a missing passage in Neumann's account. The Osiris division then carries the book's culminating transformation office. Death and transformation prevent the developmental movement from closing as the hero's permanent occupancy of a victorious identity. The canonical source navigation warrants this office and sequence; it does not yet warrant a detailed retelling of every Osiris episode. Detailed Osiris episodes require separately recovered primary tellings and comparative passages. Here the consequential change is that an ego strong enough to emerge must also become capable of transformation beyond its established form. Centroversion gathers the movement. The formation of a whole personality requires traffic between the centre and the powers from which it differentiated. Both engulfment and sovereign isolation obstruct that traffic. The former gives the centre away; the latter makes its achieved form the measure of the whole. The centre develops by admitting what changes it while retaining enough differentiation to respond. This source-specific psychological account **returns-to** [individuation and recognition](../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). [Jung's *Aion*](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the psychic distinction between ego and encompassing Self; it supplies no authorship of the notation `X/x` and no retrospective proof of Taylor's derivation. Taylor's encounter leaves the hero/spiritual-avatar distinction as a live question. The heroic sacred marriage and uroboric reabsorption cannot be merged simply because both images contain union. One follows differentiation and can sustain relationship; the other can abolish the separate position through which relationship is lived. Whether a particular avatar drama carries a different office requires its own whole telling. **Human-amplified: no** for closing that unresolved identification. The story recovered here has earned a return through differentiated participation; it has not earned permission to treat all transformations as the same event. ## #4 Taylor's paper scene makes the return performable. Begin with a blank sheet. Write `1`. Attend to the paper on which the mark appears and write `0`; attend to the act that distinguishes and relates them and inscribe the slash. The written `0/1` is now itself a determinate figure on the sheet. It too can be taken as `1` relative to the field through which it appears. Erase it. What disappears is the inscription; the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing has not been cancelled by the disappearance of this form. The sheet is an image within that capacity, not the literal substance of unobjectifiable awareness. The changed reader can begin again carrying the operation just performed. **Human-amplified: yes** for this paper/mark/slash/erasure operation in Taylor's protected Neumann encounter. The paper scene carries the more intimate pressure of Taylor's p.17 [authorial encounter](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/NOTES.md), which **sources** the connection between uroboric incest and erasure. In the encountered image, desire turns toward being dissolved and absorbed into the round. Taylor reads the `1` slipping back into `0`, then makes that movement performable on the page. The first mark, its acknowledged ground and the slash have all become a written figure. Erasing that figure releases its claim to stand as the ground it has named. The page can receive another inscription; the capacity to distinguish remains live. This changes what dissolution can accomplish. Uroboric reabsorption can surrender the differentiated position altogether; the enacted erasure can instead leave a reader able to begin again with knowledge of the inscription's dependence. The sacred marriage retains another office: differentiated partners sustain a generative relation rather than disappearing into undifferentiated containment. The p.17 encounter connects the incest motif to *hieros gamos* while questioning the priority assigned to hero and spiritual avatar. That question remains open. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's incest–self-relation–erasure amplification; **human-amplified: no** for settling the hero/avatar hierarchy. The copied Neumann passage remains uncollated, and this native use does not turn it into a quotation-ready source claim. The next page lead gives the renewed act a moving image: the self-rolling wheel. Taylor's p.18 encounter places En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel, then follows its rolling as a continuing self-composition about the unobjectified opening. The formed round must keep being made; its movement is the winding and weaving of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once and left inert. The paper's capacity for another inscription and the wheel's continuing composition meet at this renewal. Each achieved figure belongs to the field through which another figure can appear. The wheel thus **returns-to** [the uroboros's interposition](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition): a locally completed round can retain the passage through which it was made and return with a difference. The opening remains constitutive without becoming another patch of surface. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's self-composition and Text/Texture appointment. En-Soph's historical terminology, Neumann's exact p.18 wording and the encounter's proposed Whitehead comparison retain their independent source standing. Neither perpetual mechanical motion nor a topology theorem is established by a self-rolling image. The scene **figures** [the Two Ones](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and **returns-to** their concept, [0 = One, 1 = All](../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md). `0` bears the uncounted One; `1` bears All, the whole manifest field as well as each indefinite particular within it. The contrast cannot be reduced to blank material and one isolated item. The first mark opens the possibility of a world of marks. Their plurality is real, and their common condition does not become one giant object beside them. The scene consequently **returns-to** [Mono/Poly](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md): the whole is structurally prior to its determinations, while each determination contributes a real difference to the field that returns. [The native theorem spine](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the complete movement. [Six Positions, Eight Turns](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **defines** the exact relation between the positional body and its bracketed traversal: `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. These are eight determinations of one relation, with parent and return bracketing six interior determinations. They are not eight Neumann stages, and they are not the six headings of this page. The authored mythemic refraction follows their distinctions rather than deriving them from an image. The undelimited `−/−` receives the encounter's unbounded and unformed fullness. The ratified recapitulation brings En-Soph at the p.18 lead and tohubohu at p.106 to this office while retaining their distinct inherited traditions. At `0/1`, world-parent genesis figures the emergence of distinct offices within one relation. At `?/!`, the opening of light becomes the availability of a determinate answer whose question remains live. What appears can be specified because the field was capable of determination before this specification. At `−/+`, hunger, intake and expenditure give polarity its bodily tension. The two directions can work through each other; abolishing their distinction would abolish the operation. At `X/x`, determining capacity receives an indefinite particular without being exhausted by it. This is **Taylor's native QL notation**. Ego and unconscious, or ego and encompassing psychic whole, supply a named psychic refraction after that relation has been derived. At `AM/IS`, recognition becomes sayable from first-person presence and third-person predication. The slash carries the relational encounter through which those sayings meet, including the second-person address that changes both speaker and what can be said. The primordial I-am and the bounded ego's identity therefore cannot be silently equated. At `∞/dx`, the inexhaustible field meets exact local determination. The great round can figure the field carried in each finite expression, while the finite expression remains exact in its own office. An image of a circle does not establish an analytic theorem. At `1/0`, the determination returns toward the condition it cannot contain. The descent and return, the transformed personality, and the erased inscription can figure this movement precisely because each leaves a difference that has been undergone. The return is no longer unconscious containment before the separation. **Human-amplified: yes** for this eightfold refraction as explicitly developed and corrected in the authored quilt; its formal universality belongs to QL, and its Neumann correspondences remain **Argued from** the source encounter. The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition. The same cost requires both Name and Power. Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image are accompanied by Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love and Work. The visible image arrives through something lived: a need met, an alternative relinquished, a decision carried, a relation sustained. Power includes generativity and care as well as its possible capture. The Great Mother cannot simply stand for pathology, any more than the father's authority automatically stands for truth. This whole **figures** the coequal series by following what formation costs and what its return releases. The page's result is an image capable of entering another life, answerable to the work through which it came. Taylor's toroidal correction belongs at this point of developed relation. Neumann's circular perfection remains the source image; the authored refraction gives the uroboros a hole and a traffic through which taking becomes transformation. Position can present the round as a finished circle; opposition exposes head and tail, appetite and food; superposition makes their self-eating relation active in `(0/1)/(1/0)`; interposition articulates the four explicate movements together with the implicate axis and opening, with #5 enfolding what has been traversed. The trickster's circle or sphere can conceal that operative opening. The distinction concerns what the image permits the reader to do, and does not claim that every circular drawing is topologically a torus. The independent [uroboros, circulation and trickster whole](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **tests** whether shared archetypal structure has been mistaken for a closed picture; it owns the developed drama to which this local relation returns. In that authored correction Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā bears measure in manifestation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal correction, its four operations and this allocation in the ratified quilt. No claim that Neumann taught toroidal mathematics follows. [Homology and analogy](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing: the relation must state what operation is preserved, what register changes and what evidence remains with its original source. ## #5→0 The separation returns as a question of love or war. Taylor's p.121 encounter makes knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with: a distinction can individuate two terms in their relation, or claim that its cut has abolished what relates them. The marriage image bears the indelible bond of a shared genesis. Even denial takes place through the field it denies. This is a formal and mythemic assertion about relation. Separation made the world and the responsive centre possible. Its return has to preserve that achievement. The exact difference **returns-to** [the two logics of two](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). Polar distinction is necessary. Its collapse into cancellation or appropriation is a different operation: `(-1)+(+1)=0` cancels the signed terms, while `(-1)-(+1)=-2` and the inverse subtraction `(+1)-(-1)=+2` carry the two appropriative orientations. The native relation `(0/1)/(1/0)` retains the directions together without converting QL's slash into ordinary division by zero. Taylor's guilt reading locates the loss in a determination disowning its `/0`; the relation itself has not been annihilated. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cut/bond and love/war reading in the protected encounter. The claim survives with productive difference and the right of actual others to answer on their own terms. The differentiated world now sees its own means of seeing. This whole **returns-to** [contextual transparency](../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **figures** [diaphaneity](../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): light, boundary and orientation become available together with the source relations and exclusions that made them effective. [Gebser's source house](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **compares** a distinct account of consciousness structures and integral transparency. Its contextual return can illuminate this passage without equating its structures one for one with Neumann's stadial sequence. **Human-amplified: no** for such a blanket stage identity. The shared field retains both accounts in their distinct temporal and epistemic offices. The centre's power to discriminate **returns-to** [local arbitration](../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md), **qualifies** [the complex](../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md), and **extends** the question into [image, valuation and possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). An image helps organise action; possession begins when that organisation claims the authority of its own source. The Great Mother as engulfing power, the father's arresting law and the victorious hero are different possible occupants of that office. None is condemned simply for giving a world its form. [Arbitration, hybris, regard and anamnesis](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the return of judgement: the determining centre must recognise the conditions of its measure and allow encounter to alter it. [The living symbol and idol](../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) and [the archetype](../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **qualify** the source/image distinction. The image remains alive while the relation can change its meaning; its power of disclosure is lost when its present interpretation is made final. The liberated relation **returns-to** [trust, faith and the formal limit](../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [self and other without possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). Shared origin neither eliminates risk nor gives one participant ownership of another. Trust has force because the response cannot be manufactured in advance; recognition includes the possibility that an actual other changes the terms of the encounter. The captive and the heroic union carry this pressure as images. They do not prove the historical or ethical claims of every story to which those names have been applied. For [mind as worldhood](../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), to which this whole **returns-to**, the developing centre and its world form together through discrimination, valuation, inherited relation and response. The shared archetypal field supplies more than a sequence of private mental contents. It is a condition of intelligible individuation. The technical extension asks how an agent's context, memory, tools and collective relations can make that formation inspectable; artificial phenomenality and the encounter's question of a reversed individual-to-collective developmental route remain **Open**. **Human-amplified: no** for an achieved technical mechanism or a phenomenality conclusion. The structural claim is retained at full strength without inventing its implementation. This same distinction **returns-to** [idealism and order of dependence](../../../episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The primordial relation is ontologically and epistemically consequential in the essay; it is not the chronological manufacture of the world by a private ego. The centre cannot make the conditions of appearing into its possession. Its return therefore **returns-to** [compassion as loving sensitivity to origins](../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): what has become this person or this act includes nourishment, deprivation, dependence, separation and labour. Knowing those origins becomes compassion through the orientation that refuses to consume the being it understands. Responsibility remains; a more adequate field becomes available in which to exercise it. [Taylor's Draft 3 source house](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **extends** that return through the offered work and the reader's office of remembrance. Finally, this whole **qualifies** [the first advent of zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) and **returns-to** [the advent of integral zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md). The round and the paper scene do not establish the history of mathematical zero. They let the exact sign re-enter a living symbolic relation after its mathematical office has been earned. The return preserves that office. As the transformed centre retains its differentiation, the sign becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be sign. What comes back is the capacity to begin with the source relation visible in the determination: a mark made, a world opened, a separation borne, an image released to be answered. The source standing remains precise. Neumann is citation-ready, with selected external passages still unpromoted; the page leads belong to the consulted 2014 Princeton Classics encounter, whose pagination has not been collated against the 1954 English edition. Taylor's native material is internally sourced, and the protected encounter distinguishes authorial reading from its initial scaffold. **Human-amplified: no** for the scaffold's unratified one-to-one Taoist, gender or stadial equivalences. ### 3. The Māyic-threshold delineation — the eight determinations' mythic recapitulation (Frank-locked)

Frank's notes give the eight determinations a complete mythic recapitulation in one author, with page anchors: `−/−` En-Soph/tohubohu (pp. 18, 106); `0/1` the world parents' separation; `?/!` the coming of light; `−/+` hunger as systole/diastole; `X/x` ego against the unconscious ground; `AM/IS` "I am I" (with Frank's paśu correction — the Bṛhadāraṇyaka passage Neumann quotes at p. 105 shows recognition preceding separation: "I am" is prakāśa's vimarśa before pati/patni, and Neumann collapses prakāśa-vimarśa into ego); `∞/dx` the great round (Mono/Poly pleromatic); `1/0` the hero's descent and return. Frank's lock-gloss: this is the delineation of the Māyic threshold — the first unfolding into differentiation of the `0/1`, the `4+2` (+2) retaining its conditions of transformation and genesis as explicit qualities. Candidate grounding: Argument 13 (tattvic differential field) and Argument 20 (advent) via phylogenetic recapitulation. Open placement question, carried to harmonisation: plate/appendix object vs woven §4 prose register.

### 4. The energetics cap (Frank-locked)

The five-register energetics discipline closed by: the somatic floor (Van Eenwyk's systole/diastole, the gut as the body's torus, hunger/striving at `−/+`) and the physics witnesses (plasma oscillation, magnetic confinement, Floquet-driven systems from Frank's GPT chat logs — witnesses only, never theorem-authority). Frank's user-authoritative stipulation: the torus carries formal reality through all energetic registers (magnetism, Floquet physics). The cap's spine: no register's "energy" is another's substance; the torus is what persists across them (see §14 for the mathematical wing this session added).

### 5. The uroboros-torus-trickster weave (user-authoritative correction, walked across the fourfold)

The uroboros is the torus — the `4+2` — not the sphere or circle; all prior corpus treatments that read the round as sphere/perfect-circle stand corrected. The snake is the trickster precisely because the torus is passed off as the sphere (the Eden-serpent as the same figure in fallen register: the hole traded for the fork). Walked across the ponere/ballein fourfold: **position** — the circle as costume, the sphere's dead arithmetic `(-1)+(+1)=0`; **opposition** — the head/tail hunger axis; **superposition** — self-eating as `(0/1)/(1/0)` made bodily, the mouth as the operative hole; **interposition** — the uroboros as genus-one `4+2`: four explicate twisting field-lines (`#5` the enfolding whole) and two implicates (the magnetic axis + the hole = `#0`). Meta-ballein (metabolism, etymologically) accounted at this register: circulation that nourishes (assimilation/samāveśa) versus Saturn-devouring (the blocked gut as monopoly's metabolism). Register nuance recorded: this ledger's own prior line ("the torus becomes the apt symbol only after this process has been derived... the ouroboros, halo, and eternal-return images give the same operation mythematic bodies") was already toroidal — Frank's correction sharpens that line (adding the trickster's pass-off, the `4+2` explication, and the hole's proper owner) rather than demolishing it; what falls is Neumann's perfection-as-circle-sphere-round and any static "paradox held" reading.

### 6. Māyā is not the hole (user-authoritative correction)

The hole is Paramaśiva/Anuttara, the `#0`, the kṛtṛ pole. Māyā is the formal patterns Śakti's winding makes to reflect back to the hole/prakāśa via vimarśa — the measure-field, not the void it measures around. Śakti has joy/ānanda for Māyā. The plasma log already carried this unknowingly ("the axis the plasma can never occupy" = the Anuttara doctrine in physics vocabulary). Consequence carried through every layer below: wherever the weave says "the hole," its owner is Anuttara; wherever it says "Māyā," it means the winding's pattern-field.

# 6. Ouroboros · torus · trickster — the whole that keeps its hole

**Office:** supporting-visible / deep-bearing project-composed Mytheme with exact Matheme neighbour; historical ouroboros and Neumann source work remain distinct from the project's toroidal appointment.

`[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/04-MATHEMATICAL-SUBSTRATE|§3 — Mathematical Substrate — Inherited Region Recovery]]` **grounds** the exact torus relation; `[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/05-PSYCHOID-FLOWERING|§4 — Psychoid Flowering — Inherited Region Recovery]]` **returns** it into individuation and image; `[[THREAD-INTAKE-WHOLE-RELATIONAL-UNITS#Intake 001 — Self-Identity · Limit · Objective Internality · Confession · World|Intake 001]]` **extends** the inner-horizon and limit reading. The late quilt's user-authoritative correction controls this section: **the ouroboros is read toroidally; the hole belongs to Anuttara/Paramaśiva/#0, while Māyā is the measure-field wound around it rather than the hole itself.**

## The whole image

The ouroboros first appears to the eye as a snake closing upon itself: head meets tail and a line becomes a ring. That apparent circle is indispensable and insufficient. The snake is not merely a line whose ends happen to touch. It has a body, an inside and outside, a mouth through which what is other becomes what nourishes the body, and an opening around which the closed figure is organised. Its act is simultaneously return and metabolism: what goes out becomes what comes in; what is taken in changes the thing that takes it in; the returned path is not the untouched point from which it began.

The project's **trickster** enters at the moment the eye lets the visible circumference stand for the whole. The ring passes itself off as circle or sphere — a closed perfection whose centre can be treated as a point or whose interior can be imagined as filled — while the operative opening disappears from the account. The trick is not that the circumference is false. It is that a true visible determination becomes falsely exhaustive when the absence through which it is organised is read as nothing relevant.

The torus makes the missing relation exact. Its surface and its hole are inseparable in the determination of the form even though the hole never becomes another patch of surface. Close the handle and the topology changes. A loop may close on the torus while its lift remains displaced on the infinite cover; local return can therefore coexist with retained traversal-history. The form comes home without cancelling the path by which it came home.

This is the whole the ouroboros needs in the project. The mouth is not merely an emblem of endless recurrence; it is the operative aperture through which the body can take in, transform and return what it is not. Self-relation remains alive because the whole does not consume the opening into positive content.

## Matheme and the `4+2` appointment

The exact mathematical torus remains a distinct Matheme carrier:

```text
T² = R² / Z²
χ(T²) = 0
π₁(T²) ≅ Z × Z
```

The project's broader QL appointment reads the toroidal whole through the two implicate poles and four explicate relations already generated by `0/1 = 4+2`. The late correction sharpens the image:

```text
#0
hole · unobjectifiable centre · originating condition
        ↓
#1–#4
winding / differentiated surface relations
        ↓
#5
achieved whole · circulation · returned form
        ↓
5→0
surface returns to the opening its identity presupposed
```

This is an authored cross-register relation, not a claim that the ancient ouroboros encoded modern algebraic topology or QL. The mathematical result establishes its own exact torus operations; the Mytheme lets those operations become lived and psychologically consequential.

## Māyā, the winding and the trick

The distinction from Māyā is essential. **Māyā is not the absent centre.** In the mature tattvic reading Māyā is Śakti's power of finite articulation: the measure-field, patterning and contraction through which a local surface/world becomes definite around what cannot itself become one more item of that surface.

Necessary limitation is therefore not the trickster's lie. Without bounded winding there is no determinate path, no local identity and no world in which a return can occur. The fall happens one order later:

```text
finite winding becomes a real form
        ↓
its opening disappears from its own account
        ↓
the formed surface performs as self-grounding whole
        ↓
local closure is mistaken for absolute closure
```

**Hybris is the trick succeeding at the level of measure:** the bounded form forgets that its very identity depends upon what it cannot convert into bounded content.

## Jung / Neumann / individuation seam

The inherited Jungian and Neumannian round/uroboric material remains source-bearing psychic history. The project's toroidal appointment must not be retrojected into those authors as though they supplied the topology. Its gain is a correction to the *operation* the project needs from the image: individuation is not an ego becoming a perfect closed sphere. The ego, complexes, persona, archetypal agencies and inherited psychic formations remain differentiated; the wider Self-relation prevents any local formation from becoming the whole.

The torus therefore **figures** differentiated indivisibility: the local surface becomes more coherent by retaining relation to an unfilled condition, not by sealing that condition away. `[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/diaphaneity|Diaphaneity]]` and `[[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/08-deferential-intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]]` later give epistemic forms to the same return.

## What full recovery changes

A compressed “ouroboros = eternal return” loses precisely what this project needs. The whole image carries mouth, metabolism, inside/outside, return, opening, apparent circle and toroidal depth together. It shows why **closure and wholeness are not synonyms** and why an absent condition can be structurally present without becoming a positive object.

For native 018, the ouroboros/torus/trickster should therefore remain one whole Mytheme with at least three explicitly separated relations:

- historical/psychological ouroboros and round-image source work;
- exact mathematical torus operations;
- the project's authored trickster/toroidal appointment and `4+2` return.

**Source debt:** recover the exact historical ouroboros carriers actually intended for publication; keep Neumann's own wording and stadial office distinct; keep standard topology sources separate from the QL reading. None of those debts weakens the current authorial relation.

source_or_authorial_carrier_evidence.text: # Neumann — The Origins and History of Consciousness (1954) ## Bibliographic identity Erich Neumann's *The Origins and History of Consciousness*, translated from the German by R. F. C. Hull, was first published in English by Princeton University Press in 1954 (Bollingen Series XLV); the German original, *Ursprungsgeschichte des Bewusstseins*, appeared in 1949. **Consulted edition (in hand, 2026-08-05):** the Princeton Classics reissue, Princeton University Press, 2014, paperback, ISBN 978-0-691-16359-8. This is the same Hull translation and retains Jung's foreword. It is a direct reissue of the 1954 Bollingen text; pagination is assumed to reproduce the 1954 layout, but that equivalence must be confirmed against the physical copy before page-located citation. The publisher record (press.princeton.edu) corroborates edition, series, translation, and foreword; the 1954 first-edition record is corroborated by Open Library and national-library catalogue data (accessed 2026-07-16). ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note (consulted edition):** Erich Neumann, *The Origins and History of Consciousness*, trans. R. F. C. Hull, foreword by C. G. Jung, Princeton Classics ed. (Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014), {page}. **Shortened note:** Neumann, *Origins and History of Consciousness*, {page}. **Bibliography (consulted edition):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Foreword by C. G. Jung. Princeton Classics ed. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014. Originally published in German, 1949; first English edition, 1954. **First English edition (historical record):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Bollingen Series XLV. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 1954. ## Source scholarship Neumann's work is the post-Jungian historical morphology of ego formation: a phylogenetic account in which the individual ego's development recapitulates the history of consciousness as it is carried in myth. The mythic sequence — uroboros → Great Mother → separation of the world parents → birth of the hero → slaying of the mother → slaying of the father → transformation → liberation of the captive — is read as the progressive differentiation of ego-consciousness from the maternal-unconscious ground. Part II maps the same sequence onto the historical stages of ego-consciousness proper. Relevant operations for this essay: - **The uroboros** — the self-containing round, the pre-egoic psychic whole that holds both parents in one figure; the psyche's own image of the undifferentiated condition before the cut. - **The Great Mother** — the maternal uroboros as the first object-face of the unconscious; the archetype's split into good/bad mother. - **The separation of the world parents** — the first differentiation of the primordial couple (Father Heaven / Mother Earth); the principle of opposites born from the one round. The split of the archetype into good and evil figures (the two parents, the twins) belongs to this same movement. - **The hero** — the evolving ego-consciousness; the hero's slayings (of the mother, of the father) are the ego's achieved differentiations, and his descent/return is the relation back through the ground it left. - **The transformation stage** — consciousness opening beyond the ego-hero toward the transpersonal; the inner counterpart of the ego's outward victories. - **The ascent of consciousness and the species-name (p. 16, lead)** — consciousness as the "unnatural" thing in nature, specific to the species that "has justly styled himself Homo sapiens"; the struggle between the specifically human and the universally natural constitutes the history of conscious development. Transcription pending collation against the physical 2014 copy. The word-field this passage opens (homo/humus, sapiens/sapientia) is the project's own reading, carried in the earth/taste/wisdom etymology history; it is not Neumann's claim. whole_to_consumer_paragraphs.text: The return has to preserve the two who can recognise their shared genesis. Blending them would destroy the difference through which recognition occurs; victory understood as abolishing the other's ground would perpetuate the divorce. The prior `0` returns as their condition, rather than as the null result of their collision. The narrative pressure is therefore the same one that will meet the hero: what kind of separation permits a life in relation, and what kind makes continued separation its war? This authored image **returns-to** [A13's two logics](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) through the changed operator, and **returns-to** [A18's complete field](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) without substituting two gods for its eight determinations.

The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition.

Neumann's comparative morphology supplies the shared separation field; it is not being cited as the source of Taylor's notation or as verification of this named religious history. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. whole_evidence.text: The next page lead gives the renewed act a moving image: the self-rolling wheel. Taylor's p.18 encounter places En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel, then follows its rolling as a continuing self-composition about the unobjectified opening. The formed round must keep being made; its movement is the winding and weaving of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once and left inert. The paper's capacity for another inscription and the wheel's continuing composition meet at this renewal. Each achieved figure belongs to the field through which another figure can appear. The wheel thus **returns-to** [the uroboros's interposition](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition): a locally completed round can retain the passage through which it was made and return with a difference. The opening remains constitutive without becoming another patch of surface. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's self-composition and Text/Texture appointment. En-Soph's historical terminology, Neumann's exact p.18 wording and the encounter's proposed Whitehead comparison retain their independent source standing. Neither perpetual mechanical motion nor a topology theorem is established by a self-rolling image. The scene **figures** [the Two Ones](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and **returns-to** their concept, [0 = One, 1 = All](../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md). `0` bears the uncounted One; `1` bears All, the whole manifest field as well as each indefinite particular within it. The contrast cannot be reduced to blank material and one isolated item. The first mark opens the possibility of a world of marks. Their plurality is real, and their common condition does not become one giant object beside them. The scene consequently **returns-to** [Mono/Poly](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md): the whole is structurally prior to its determinations, while each determination contributes a real difference to the field that returns. [The native theorem spine](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the complete movement. [Six Positions, Eight Turns](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **defines** the exact relation between the positional body and its bracketed traversal: `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. These are eight determinations of one relation, with parent and return bracketing six interior determinations. They are not eight Neumann stages, and they are not the six headings of this page. The authored mythemic refraction follows their distinctions rather than deriving them from an image. The undelimited `−/−` receives the encounter's unbounded and unformed fullness. The ratified recapitulation brings En-Soph at the p.18 lead and tohubohu at p.106 to this office while retaining their distinct inherited traditions. At `0/1`, world-parent genesis figures the emergence of distinct offices within one relation. At `?/!`, the opening of light becomes the availability of a determinate answer whose question remains live. What appears can be specified because the field was capable of determination before this specification. At `−/+`, hunger, intake and expenditure give polarity its bodily tension. The two directions can work through each other; abolishing their distinction would abolish the operation. At `X/x`, determining capacity receives an indefinite particular without being exhausted by it. This is **Taylor's native QL notation**. Ego and unconscious, or ego and encompassing psychic whole, supply a named psychic refraction after that relation has been derived. At `AM/IS`, recognition becomes sayable from first-person presence and third-person predication. The slash carries the relational encounter through which those sayings meet, including the second-person address that changes both speaker and what can be said. The primordial I-am and the bounded ego's identity therefore cannot be silently equated. At `∞/dx`, the inexhaustible field meets exact local determination. The great round can figure the field carried in each finite expression, while the finite expression remains exact in its own office. An image of a circle does not establish an analytic theorem. At `1/0`, the determination returns toward the condition it cannot contain. The descent and return, the transformed personality, and the erased inscription can figure this movement precisely because each leaves a difference that has been undergone. The return is no longer unconscious containment before the separation. **Human-amplified: yes** for this eightfold refraction as explicitly developed and corrected in the authored quilt; its formal universality belongs to QL, and its Neumann correspondences remain **Argued from** the source encounter. The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition. The same cost requires both Name and Power. Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image are accompanied by Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love and Work. The visible image arrives through something lived: a need met, an alternative relinquished, a decision carried, a relation sustained. Power includes generativity and care as well as its possible capture. The Great Mother cannot simply stand for pathology, any more than the father's authority automatically stands for truth. This whole **figures** the coequal series by following what formation costs and what its return releases. The page's result is an image capable of entering another life, answerable to the work through which it came. Taylor's toroidal correction belongs at this point of developed relation. Neumann's circular perfection remains the source image; the authored refraction gives the uroboros a hole and a traffic through which taking becomes transformation. Position can present the round as a finished circle; opposition exposes head and tail, appetite and food; superposition makes their self-eating relation active in `(0/1)/(1/0)`; interposition articulates the four explicate movements together with the implicate axis and opening, with #5 enfolding what has been traversed. The trickster's circle or sphere can conceal that operative opening. The distinction concerns what the image permits the reader to do, and does not claim that every circular drawing is topologically a torus. The independent [uroboros, circulation and trickster whole](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **tests** whether shared archetypal structure has been mistaken for a closed picture; it owns the developed drama to which this local relation returns. In that authored correction Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā bears measure in manifestation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal correction, its four operations and this allocation in the ratified quilt. No claim that Neumann taught toroidal mathematics follows. [Homology and analogy](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing: the relation must state what operation is preserved, what register changes and what evidence remains with its original source.
